title.en: Open several workspaces side by side in tabs
title.zh: 以标签形式同时打开多个工作区

description.en: Each workspace you open now gets its own tab at the top of the window, so you can switch between them with one click instead of returning to All Workspaces. Every tab keeps its thread, scroll position and unsent message while you work elsewhere, and the tabs stay open when you visit All Workspaces or Device. Closing a tab only closes its page; the workspace and this computer's agents keep running.
description.zh: 打开的每个工作区都会在窗口顶部显示为独立标签，点击即可直接切换，无需返回「全部工作区」。切换期间各标签保留原有的会话、浏览位置与未发送内容；进入「全部工作区」或「本机管理」后，已打开的标签仍会保留。关闭标签仅关闭对应页面，不影响工作区本身及本机智能体的运行。

description.en: Press ⌘1–⌘8 (Ctrl+1–Ctrl+8 on Windows) to jump to a tab and ⌘9 (Ctrl+9) for the last one. With five or more tabs open, a menu at the end of the tab bar lists them all along with their shortcuts.
description.zh: 按 ⌘1–⌘8（Windows 为 Ctrl+1–Ctrl+8）可切换到对应标签，⌘9（Ctrl+9）切换到最后一个标签。打开五个及以上标签时，标签栏末尾会提供菜单，列出全部标签及其快捷键。

title.en: Connect Agents brings agent setup into one place
title.zh: 「连接智能体」统一智能体的安装与管理

description.en: Device Overview and Agent Marketplace are now a single Connect Agents page. It opens with recommended agents — Codex, Claude, OpenCode and Hermes — each one click from its setup, with Browse and connect more agents for every other type. Agents you add appear straight away under Connected agents, and you can add several of the same type, each with its own name and workspace.
description.zh: 「设备概览」与「智能体市场」合并为「连接智能体」页面。页面顶部推荐 Codex、Claude、OpenCode 和 Hermes，点击「立即安装」即可进入对应配置；其他类型可通过「查看并连接更多智能体」添加。添加完成的智能体会立即出现在「已连接的智能体」列表中，同一类型也可以添加多个，分别命名并加入不同的工作区。

title.en: Join a workspace straight from the welcome screen
title.zh: 从欢迎页直接加入工作区

description.en: Use OpenAgents on the welcome screen now goes straight to the pairing code, and the pairing form explains where to get one. When you add an agent to a workspace before this computer has joined any, you can get a code and enter it in the same dialog, and the agent joins that workspace as soon as the code is accepted.
description.zh: 欢迎页的「使用OpenAgents」按钮会直接打开配对码输入框，并说明配对码的获取方式。若本机尚未加入任何工作区，把智能体加入工作区时可在同一弹窗中获取并输入配对码，配对成功后智能体随即加入该工作区。

title.en: Joined Workspaces shows this device at a glance
title.zh: 「本机加入的工作区」页面展示设备概况

description.en: Join workspace now sits right under the page title, and a summary below it shows this device and the workspaces it has joined, each one click away.
description.zh: 「加入工作区」按钮移至页面标题下方，其下新增设备概况，展示本机名称及已加入的工作区，点击即可打开对应工作区。
